comment: MapStart coverage (PROT-04). The MapStart WIRE layout is a single uint32 mapSize and is VERSION-INDEPENDENT (Phase-3 D-13, ProtocolCodec.cpp:419-431) — the codec always ReadInt()s the size regardless of protocol version. The 0.75-vs-0.76 'with/without map-size' distinction (D-05) is a NetClient SEND-side side-effect (if protocolVersion==4 SendMapCached(), NetClient.cpp:947) plus an SPLog of the size, NOT a recv-driven wire difference. The MapStartBothVersions replay test asserts this byte string decodes to the SAME mapSize whether driven with protocolVersion 3 or 4.
